title: BC Friday Tips #80 Business Central Trivia
summary: Business Central Trivia is a website where users can test their BC knowledge, earn points, and compete on a leaderboard. It provides an engaging alternative to traditional training materials for consultants, developers, and power users.
key_points: Business Central Trivia is an online platform at businesscentraltrivia.com for testing BC knowledge
Users can earn points and compete against other developers, consultants, and power users on a leaderboard
It offers a more engaging way to learn compared to traditional training documentation
The platform is designed for BC professionals to sharpen their skills

quotes.text: A fun way to sharpen your BC knowledge
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the practical benefit of using the platform for professional development

quotes.text: More engaging than yet another training document
quotes.why_it_matters: Emphasizes the gamified approach makes learning more motivating than traditional resources
